title: World & Setting identity-state taxonomy

identity_state_layers.definition: Reusable source-backed identity, type, names, premise, descriptors, and stable setting metadata.
identity_state_layers.not: Campaign-local state or current Scene state.

identity_state_layers.definition: Explicit source-backed placement in branches, planes, layers, realities, eras, or other cosmological containers.
identity_state_layers.not: A hierarchy inferred from thematic similarity or co-occurrence.

identity_state_layers.definition: Typed source-backed containment and location relations among worlds, realms, regions, zones, settlements, districts, stations, ships, routes, landmarks, and sites.
Setting-attached or reusable environment/biome/hazard/resource/traversal context with provenance.
identity_state_layers.not: Automatic instantiation of a generic environment template.

identity_state_layers.definition: Source-backed settlements, structures, infrastructure, landmarks, portals, roads, hubs, and constructed locations.
identity_state_layers.not: Generic Item/Vehicle ownership or live runtime position.

identity_state_layers.definition: Setting-scoped factions, organizations, governments, corporations, institutions, jurisdictions, and authority relations.
identity_state_layers.not: Campaign-local current faction metrics or generic relationship mechanics.

identity_state_layers.definition: Setting-scoped cultures, societies, religions, languages, calendars, customs, economies, and social structures.
identity_state_layers.not: Species biology or immutable Character traits.

identity_state_layers.definition: Source-backed eras, historical events, chronology, causal relations, and unresolved chronology conflicts.
identity_state_layers.not: Current Campaign timeline or inferred chronology.

identity_state_layers.definition: Setting availability, membership, provenance, and world-local extension metadata for Species, Creatures/NPCs, Items, Vehicles, Abilities, and other governed objects.
identity_state_layers.not: Replacement of the owning object definition domain.

identity_state_layers.definition: Rules or mechanics explicitly scoped to a world, reality, branch, plane, zone, or setting context.
Explicit roads, portals, routes, adjacency, access rules, and inter-setting connectivity.
identity_state_layers.not: Connectivity inferred from shared organizations or multiversal context.

identity_state_layers.definition: Campaign-local instantiation, changed/destroyed/occupied state, current control, discovery, and Scene/session context referencing reusable setting definitions.
Role- and Campaign-scoped reveal, discovery, secret, GM-only, rumor, and knowledge projection state.
identity_state_layers.not: Source truth itself; hidden truth remains source-backed but filtered.

identity_state_layers.definition: Source references, assertions, conflicts, revisions, authoring decisions, history, export, recovery, expected-version, and idempotency metadata.

invariants: world-local content remains scoped absent explicit promotion authority
definition state is separate from campaign/runtime state
relations require explicit source or governed authoring evidence
generic environment template does not imply setting membership
world-local extensions do not replace owning domain definitions
authoring aids and AI output remain proposals until governed acceptance
unknown and conflicted source state remain explicit
permission filtering occurs before aggregation and AI context
maps are supplemental; accessible textual/nonvisual operation is required
mutations require governed authority, expected-version checks and idempotent recovery
no application runtime activation is authorized
